title: COPY callback: cipher devCtx not guarded — aliased Aes.devCtx causes double-free
description: Trigger: wc_AesCopy(&dst, &src) where src.devId == WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID and src.devCtx != NULL (i.e., SETKEY has run). Path: WC_ALGO_TYPE_COPY callback with copy.algo == WC_ALGO_TYPE_CIPHER returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE without checking src devCtx; wolfSSL falls through to XMEMCPY of the Aes struct; dst.devCtx = src.devCtx (same heap pointer). wc_AesFree(src) → crypto2dev_free_cipher → ForceZero+XFREE(src.devCtx); dst.devCtx now dangling. wc_AesFree(dst) → crypto2dev_free_cipher → ForceZero(dangling ptr) + XFREE(dangling ptr): use-after-free + double-free. The hash COPY path (WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH) already correctly returns WC_HW_E when src_devctx != NULL; the cipher path needs the same guard. Fix: in WC_ALGO_TYPE_COPY handler, add a devCtx check for WC_ALGO_TYPE_CIPHER analogous to the existing WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH check.
